platform: Linux aarch64 container on Docker Linux VM / Apple M1 Max

method.warning_validation: full vector equality with retained original linear reference; expected count and earliest covering rule also checked
method.scope: rule-file loading, one Router compilation, full shadow_warnings scan; no main config parse or CLI output

selection_note: Use the first standalone final lint run. A later Cargo substring filter also ran lint alongside routing; that duplicate run is excluded. Routing was rerun alone by exact name using the same compiled binary in a network-disabled container.
limitations: Warm temporary-file cache; generated config, fixture writes and output are excluded.
One process per case, five repeated scans, no CPU affinity or control of background activity.
RSS includes test harness/configuration/allocator retention; not isolated index memory.
Current supported limits only; larger capacities, production startup and long-running workloads are unverified.
